scope: Current working tree; no production deployment or production data mutation

approved_fixes.burrow_icons: All eight entrances use the supplied local artwork; stale paths and duplicate filename suffix fixed
approved_fixes.wallet: True safe-integer balance is retained for persistence, receipts and spending; display is 99999+ at or above 99999 and exact below it
approved_fixes.sharing: Default sharing retained; no privacy toggle added; paired composition screens include a neutral visibility description; historical authorization and account isolation retained
approved_fixes.secure_storage: Native AES-256 MMKV, key in OS Keychain/Keystore; verified resumable copy migration and asynchronous legacy session migration; no plaintext fallback on vault failure
approved_fixes.continuous_motion: Affection SVG/progress and watering physics render on the UI thread; feeding progress renders natively; business duration, thresholds and single-completion guards retained
approved_fixes.accessibility: Feed/water activation alternatives; real 48pt wallet touch bounds preserve the original visual pill, flow height and reward anchor
approved_fixes.audio_haptics: Persistent independent sound and haptic preferences; automatic audio respects silent mode; explicit Surprise voice playback retained
approved_fixes.errors: Presentation-boundary friendly errors; original codes still drive pairing, payment, entitlement and retry decisions
